ns2:section.sectionText: Designed to improve the international student's ability to speak and understand English in the business setting at normal conversational speed and to give the student the ability to continue improving pronunciation skills after the course is finished. Focus on the rhythm, stress, intonation, and sounds of natural speech, and the use of ordinary English spelling to guide the pronunciation of newly encountered words. No student will be permitted to remain in the class who does not take the Diagnostic Test administered during the first three class meetings and show demonstrated need.
